entities.name: Anne Boleyn
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Anne Boleyn was Queen of England from 1533 to 1536 as the second wife of Henry VIII. Her marriage to Henry precipitated the Break with Rome and the English Reformation. She was the mother of Elizabeth I. Accused of adultery and treason, she was beheaded at the Tower of London.
